1 official facility · Milton, FL

Passport offices in Milton, Florida

The official place to submit a passport application (Form DS-11) in Milton — with direct phone numbers, hours and services, straight from the State Department's facility database.

SRC CLERK OF COURTS

6495 CAROLINE ST · (850) 983-1966

Photos on-site Accessible Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM

Applying in Milton: the short version

  • First passport or child under 16? You must apply in person at one of the facilities above with an unsigned DS-11, citizenship evidence, photo ID and photos. Fees here.
  • Renewing an adult passport? Skip the trip — renew by mail or online for $130, no execution fee.
  • Traveling within 14 days? Facilities in Milton can't rush it. You need a regional agency appointment or expedited service (+$60, 2-3 weeks).

Frequently asked questions

Do I need an appointment for a passport in Milton?

It depends on the facility. USPS locations in Milton use the online scheduler at usps.com, while libraries and clerk offices set their own rules — some take walk-ins. Each listing above shows the facility's phone and scheduling link so you can confirm in one call.

How much will it cost?

A first-time adult passport book is $165 total ($130 application fee + $35 execution fee paid at the facility in Milton). Children under 16 pay $135. Expedited processing adds $60. Renewals by mail or online are $130 with no facility visit needed.

Can I get my passport the same day in Milton?

Acceptance facilities cannot issue passports — they forward your application. For genuinely urgent travel (within 14 days), you need an appointment at a regional passport agency, booked through 1-877-487-2778. See our expedited guide for the fastest legitimate routes.
